concern_summary: This concern pertains to the functionalities that involve chat participants in a money request process, emphasizing the intersection with policy expense classification.
This concern is centered around functionalities specifically addressing Policy Expense Chats, including classification, access control, and management of invited members.
This concern relates to the management of chat messages, including the handling of message displays and interactions, especially within the context of transactions.
Interaction and display functionalities for expense reports within chat contexts, including the optimistic construction of reports and management of related communications.
This concern highlights the integration of chat reporting functionalities related to expense discussions, linking actions and messages to identified expense report contexts.

This concern focuses on managing invoice chat reports, which includes the creation and retrieval of reports as well as determining parameters for sending invoices based on existing or newly created chat reports.
